sources.title: Automated brain tumor detection in MRI images using CNN and ResNet ...
sources.snippet: Accurate and early diagnosis of brain tumors remains challenging due to the complexity of brain structures and reliance on manual interpretation. This work presents an automated deep learning-based approach for brain tumor detection from MRI images using Convolutional Neural Networks and Residual Networks.
